meta.description: In January 2026, Bandai Namco Filmworks announced an new anime project titled Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Die Graue Hexe. It is set to premiere in 2026 will be produced by Sunrise with production assistance by Production I.G, and will be part of a series of projects commemorating studio Sunrise's 50th anniversary to be released between 2026 and 2028.
